meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 16-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (5 agents) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Automatically review code changes before release to ensure quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent automated code review before npm publish

howto.what: 用户要求发布前审查时,Claude 会先找出自上次 npm 发布以来的所有改动,接着并行派出最多16个审查员分三层检查,最终给出逐项通过/失败判定、风险等级、破坏性变更、版本号建议和更新日志草稿。
howto.when: 仅当用户明确要求做发布前审查时触发,例如“pre-publish review”“release review”等。普通“发布/上线”请求不会触发,会直接走 /publish。

say.note: Claude 会检测未发布改动并启动分层审查。

say.text: 我准备发 npm,先做个 release review。
say.note: 会得到发布就绪评估和版本号建议。

say.text: 先 review before publish,看看能不能发。
say.note: 会检查未发布改动,给出能否发布的结果。

howto.what_en: When a pre-publish review is requested, Claude detects all changes since the last npm release, runs up to 16 agents in three layers, and returns per-group pass/fail verdicts, risk, breaking changes, version advice, changelog draft.
howto.when_en: Runs only when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review, e.g., 'pre-publish review', 'release review', etc. A plain publish/release request must not trigger it; /publish ships directly.

say_en.note: Claude detects unpublished changes and starts review.

say_en.text: I'm about to publish to npm; run a release review first.
say_en.note: You'll get readiness and version-bump advice.

say_en.text: Do a review before publish — can we ship?
say_en.note: Claude checks unpublished changes and returns go/no-go.
